DeployBot: :rotating_light: Rollback initiated for service `runtime` (env=prod-us-east)
DeployBot: Reason: surge in 5xx errors after deploy. Rolling back from tag `v1.4.2` (commit abc1234) to pinned `v1.4.1`.
DeployBot: Rollback steps started — reverting deployment and pinning previous release. ETA ~3m.
sara_h: ACK. I'll run quick smoke tests once it's back up.
timothy.l: Any idea what triggered the spike? logs/alerts?
sara_h: Grafana shows increased latency + error rate starting ~2026-03-20T12:04Z, aligns with canary traffic for v1.4.2.
jen-ops: Pinning `v1.4.1` in the console now: `release.pin("runtime", "v1.4.1")` :white_check_mark:
monitoring-bot: CI pipeline canceled for v1.4.2 deploy; healthchecks paused for rollback window.
DeployBot: Rollback completed — runtime is now on `v1.4.1` (commit def9876). Services reporting healthy.
sara_h: smoke test: `curl -sS https://runtime.prod-us-east.internal/health | jq .status` -> "ok" :white_check_mark:
timothy.l: Traces show elevated tail latency in the new KV cache code path. Assigning to @platform-team to triage.
jen-ops: Added temporary routing rule to divert canary traffic away from v1.4.2 hosts.
sara_h: Monitoring for 30m, will post an update here. @oncall please watch 500s and latency dashboards.
monitoring-bot: Alert subscription added for this thread: #prod-500s, #runtime-latency.
DeployBot: Revert-deploy finished and release-state updated. Release notes updated: https://redwood.internal/releases/notes/v1.4.1-rollback-1937654321
sara_h: Thanks — leaving pin in place until root cause is confirmed. Marking for postmortem if instability continues.
jen-ops: Preparing rollback changelog and a short remediation playbook.
DeployBot: Tags: active->v1.4.1, rolled-back->v1.4.2 (do not promote).
